premises.text: Organizations relying on large contractor/vendor networks lack formal ways to find, engage, and coordinate them across emails, spreadsheets, and fragmented document tools
premises.evidence_span: This whole workflow process between companies to outsource parties is a complete mess and super inefficient

premises.text: Listable provides a searchable internal contractor index with flexible onboarding templates and forms shared by link
premises.evidence_span: All of their contributor network information, past and future, will be stored in one place

premises.text: Project booking creates dual private/shared tracking, object-based email-integrated communication, auto feedback requests, and centralized invoice approval/payment across many countries
premises.evidence_span: onboard, manage, communicate with, and pay these huge contributor networks

premises.text: SaaS freemium model so any company can sign up and use the product for free, serving diverse contractor-heavy industries
premises.evidence_span: we're a SaaS company with a freemium model

value.text: A workable system for companies to collaborate with large external contributor and contractor networks
value.evidence_span: facilitating a new way of working together

causal_links.evidence_span: we had no formalized way to handle this
